topic: The real Japanese city that sued an anime for destroying its reputation
hook: A real city sued an anime for destroying its image.
script: A real city sued an anime for destroying its image. When the anime Another depicted the fictional city of Yomiyama as cursed and plagued by mysterious student deaths, the real city of Toyama — which the fictional city was clearly modelled on — faced a significant drop in tourism. Local businesses reported losses. City officials formally complained to the studio. A legal settlement was reached quietly. The anime was not pulled.
